lessons_this_round: the vertical rhythm sampler and the emitter must apply the same cursor rule, or the sampled population is not the population being written; a sub-line artefact that only one of them sees becomes a paragraph spacing of its own

a shared spacing value must be its class's largest member with a fixed comparison anchor: rounding down to the class minimum tightened the P3 form region until a source row was dropped, and a moving representative would let near-misses chain one class across the whole gap population

the region reflow plan's width model and the emitter's real font metrics can disagree at an anchor by a fraction of a point; when they do, the emitter's own measurement must win, or the plan demands a generated row the page cannot hold and displaces every row below it by one pitch
